#### Application deadlines for 2027/2028

Extra-EU students requiring a visa application: [...] Deadline: September 15, 2027

#### Requirements

The AI for Connected Industries Master admits students willing to pursue a master degree in English, and possessing a Bachelor in one of these fields: Computer Science, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, ICT Engineering.  
Late obtention of the bachelor degree until September is acceptable, provided transcripts of the last years are transmitted.

Admission is also possible at the M2 (2ndyear level) if you can justify 4 years of study in one of the fields above with equivalent M1 (1styear) courses.

results.title: Master's Degrees in France (2027 Guide)
results.snippet:
To apply for a Master’s degree in France, you typically need to prepare the following documents:

    Undergraduate degree certificate (for degrees obtained outside France, a translation into French might be required)
    Proof of English skills (such as IELTS or TOEFL score certificates)
    A detailed curriculum vitae / résumé
    A personal statement describing your personal and career goals
    References or letters of recommendation
    For non-EU students: a copy of their photo ID/passport, or a copy of the residency permit (carte de séjour), or a confirmation of receipt of the residency permit application for the current year
    Overview of personal work (portfolio, bibliography, thesis, research project, etc.)
    Questionnaire by the university [...] Students who are citizens of the EU, EEA, Switzerland or Andorra pay tuition fees of €243 per year (not quite for free but almost) at universities and usually €601 at schools of Engineering (but there might be different fees - make sure to ask).
    International students from other countries pay tuition fees of €3,770 per year for their Masters.

   At private institutions and especially at many of France’s well-renowned business schools the Masters tuition fees will be higher, up to around €25,000 per year.
4. ### Find out how to apply 💡

   The application process for Master’s degrees in France depends on a few main factors: your nationality, your current country of residence, and which type of institution(s) you want to apply to.

   For public universities, it works like this: [...] The French capital has hundreds of direct flights that connect it with most countries on all continents. If you travel from Europe, France’s central location makes it very easy to reach by train or bus.

    Within the country, you’ll find a robust network of high-speed trains that makes it easy to reach other student cities such as Lyon, Toulouse or Bordeaux.

    Bon voyage!

### Typical duration

Masters in France mostly take between 1 year and 2 years to complete.

### Typical tuition fees

At public universities, students from the EU/EEA pay either €243 or €601 per year, and other international students pay €3,770. At private universities and business schools, fees are higher, up to around €25,000 per year.

results.title: 2027 AI Master's Degrees for International Students in the U.S. | Research.com
results.snippet:
What are some typical admission requirements for international students applying to AI master's programs in the U.S. in 2027?

International students typically need a bachelor's degree in a related field, TOEFL or IELTS scores for English proficiency, GRE scores, letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, and sometimes coding experience to apply for AI master's programs in the U.S. in 2027.

Are there internship opportunities for international students in AI master's programs in the U.S.?

Yes, AI master's programs in the U.S. often offer internship opportunities for international students. These internships provide practical experience and can be a part of the program curriculum. Students should check their school's partnerships with tech companies for available positions. [...] Stanford University’s Master of Science in Computer Science includes an AI track with access to research activity and Silicon Valley employer networks. MIT’s Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science includes AI-related coursework in machine learning, robotics, and data science. Carnegie Mellon University’s dedicated machine learning master’s program is known for research depth and industry connections. UC Berkeley’s Master of Information and Data Science offers AI-related electives with an applied, real-world orientation. [...] Top-ranked U.S. AI master’s options for international students are often found at universities with strong computer science, engineering, machine learning, and data science departments. Commonly cited institutions include Stanford University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Carnegie Mellon University, and the University of California, Berkeley. These schools may offer a dedicated AI or machine learning master’s degree, or they may offer AI-focused tracks inside computer science, electrical engineering, data science, or information programs.
